name: [🎆 New Year Part 3] Anime World Tower Defense
desc:
Welcome to AWTD!
You have been summoned to AWTD to find and defeat the Corrupted Hero! The Corrupted Hero is summoning his armies leaving a trail of endless destruction across the lands of AWTD as he get's ever closer with every update...

Summon and train your units, battle the Corrupt Hero's armies and restore hope, freedom and justice in the land of AWTD!

AWTD offers :
🍖 Unique mechanics that no anime TD game in roblox offers yet
😎 Great community and listening developers 
😈 COLLECT A BUNCH OF CHARACTERS
🎧 Many gamemodes and much to do!

Have fun! And get ready to defeat the corrupted hero!
